scope: Retire NGE expertise, item, buff, cybernetic proc, cybernetic special-command, and reactive combat-proc runtime for players while preserving Publish 14.1 combat authority and retained expansion NPC encounter mechanics.

findings: The pinned Publish 14.1 combat runtime has no NGE expertise, item-proc, cybernetic-proc, or reactive-proc list authority.
The inherited login, weapon, wearable, buff, and cybernetic callbacks rebuild later-era proc lists even after NGE expertise and class admission are retired.
Authenticated PRE-CU combat already bypasses proc execution, but persisted lists and retained unprofiled commands leave a player-runtime reachability gap.
The shared expertise cache helper is reached directly by player login and delayed buff callbacks, so the downstream proc builders alone did not prevent a transient NGE expertise-proc list write.

Seven retained expansion cybernetic rows directly grant seven NGE combat commands on equip; the pinned Publish 14.1 runtime has none of those commands, and retained item data must not become player combat authority.
